title: Paper White 2: the Following Pokémon's gifts, res/paperwhite2/following/items.json
description: Items the follower gives the player when talked to in given places and conditions, each slot once a Pokémon (member 0 of following/contextual-items.narc of Pokeweb's runtime, "FWTI"), packed by tools/paperwhite2/following_assets.py as member 5 of the model table's archive (a/0/4/7), whose docstring has the format: ABI 1 with 28-byte rows, ABI 2 with 36-byte rows when a rule has tile bounds. The runtime takes the first rule in order whose slot the Pokémon hasn't given yet and that matches; a rule without a condition matches any. The Pokémon keeps the slots it has given in its data. The packed member and its one-member NARC must fit the runtime's 4 KB page. A string value is the name of a constant from generated/.

slot.description: The gift's slot, 0 to 9: a Pokémon gives each slot once

item_name.description: The item's name as {item} shows it, at most 191 characters, on one line

text.description: The text, at most 191 characters: \n starts a line, {nickname} is the Pokémon's nickname, {player} the player's name, {location} the zone, as "Zone N", {item} the item_name

zone.description: The zone it is given in; not ZONE_BLACK_CITY, whose 0 stands for any

form.description: The follower's form, which needs a species

hp.description: The HP the Pokémon has left

status.description: The Pokémon's status condition (poison takes in bad poison, any_status any but healthy)

facing.description: The way the Pokémon faces to look at the player, which is where the player stands from it

tile_bounds.description: The tiles of the zone's matrix the player must stand in, inclusive: x goes east, y south; any of the four
